newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia household savings ratio revised up.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia household savings ratio revised up.

text.p: The Australian Bureau of Statistics on Wednesday reported the seasonally adjusted Australia's household savings ratio was 4.8 percent in the December quarter, from a revised 4.5 percent in the September, which was originally reported as 2.9 percent.
The June quarter savings ratio was revised to 4.5 percent from 3.0 percent and March quarter to 3.9 percent from 2.3 percent.
